title: Herdr runner adapter & conventions
description: Layer 1, docs+config only. Deliver skills/ticks/references/herdr-runner.md (map the runner-neutral contract onto herdr primitives: worktree create -> agent start -> prompt --wait -> collect via commits+RESULT.md, never terminal scraping; blocked = human escalation; crash reconcile via .tick/ + herdr agent list + agent_session IDs), a per-kind spawn/full-auto capability matrix, the .tick/runners.toml routing config (role/tier -> kind+model args, plus orchestration.substrate = herdr|harness|auto with HERDR_ENV/socket detection and explicit graceful fallback to the harness adapter), and wire herdr as an optional substrate into agent-runner.md + SKILL.md without replacing the four harness adapters. Prove it with a live heterogeneous smoke test.
acceptance_criteria: An orchestrator in any harness inside a herdr pane runs a toy epic end-to-end following only herdr-runner.md + runners.toml, with two workers of different agent kinds; results flow via branch commits + RESULT.md (no terminal scraping); substrate auto-detection documented and demonstrated: same config outside herdr falls back to harness orchestration with an explicit message; smoke-test field report recorded and doc fixes folded back.
